business_day_definition: Monday to Friday excluding no holidays in the demonstration calendar

session.secure_cookie_note: Set to true behind a local TLS endpoint; the demonstration runs on loopback over plain HTTP.

reason_codes.label: Incomplete application
reason_codes.description: The application does not state everything the permit type requires.

reason_codes.label: Withdrawn by applicant
reason_codes.description: The applicant asked for the application to be withdrawn.

reason_codes.label: Duplicate submission
reason_codes.description: The application repeats an application the City already holds.

reason_codes.label: Does not meet code
reason_codes.description: The proposed work does not meet the published ACME Code rules.

reason_codes.label: Outside jurisdiction
reason_codes.description: The property lies outside the jurisdiction of ACME City.

reason_codes.label: Site not resolved
reason_codes.description: The City could not resolve the property of the work against the official records.

reason_codes.label: A published rule is not met
reason_codes.description: The proposed work does not meet a published ACME Code rule.

reason_codes.label: Minor document defect
reason_codes.description: The document defect does not change how the work is assessed.

reason_codes.label: Verified duplicate
reason_codes.description: A person confirmed the duplicate and the case may continue.

reason_codes.label: Plans need revision
reason_codes.description: The plans must be revised before the case can be assessed.

reason_codes.label: A stated fact needs correcting
reason_codes.description: A stated fact must be corrected before the case can be assessed.

reason_codes.label: Duplicate record
reason_codes.description: The case repeats a record the City already holds.

scenarios.title: Main case
scenarios.condition: An organization alias, an ambiguous unit address and a payment under a legacy finance account identifier.

scenarios.title: False friend
scenarios.condition: A second organization in the same building with a similar name.

scenarios.title: Expired contractor credential
scenarios.condition: A contractor registration that expired before the required decision date.

scenarios.title: Unknown parcel
scenarios.condition: A submitted parcel identifier that no GIS record resolves.

scenarios.title: Profile update
scenarios.condition: An applicant updates contact details after submission.

scenarios.title: Source correction failure
scenarios.condition: A GIS correction that the source rejects or delays.

scenarios.title: Post-issuance change
scenarios.condition: A rule, fee or master change after a permit was issued.

scenarios.title: Replayed transactions
scenarios.condition: Repeated imports, payment delivery, allocation command and publication.

scenarios.title: Invalid extraction inputs
scenarios.condition: Non-numeric, non-finite, missing conditional and unsupported category values.

scenarios.title: Unowned feed
scenarios.condition: A feed that arrives without an accountable owner or steward queue.

scenarios.title: Financial exceptions
scenarios.condition: Partial, overpaid, reversed, unsettled, unmatched and incompatible currency payments.
